name: command-menu
summary: Searches grouped application destinations in a native dialog while retaining a real fallback link.

agent.useWhen: Users repeatedly navigate among many URL-backed application destinations.
agent.avoidWhen: A few visible links suffice, the action mutates state, or the destination is not a safe URL.

contract.role: searchable native dialog containing grouped destination links
invariants: Configuration is typed plain data; labels, descriptions, keywords and shortcuts are escaped, never interpreted as markup.
One to eight groups contain one to twenty items each and no more than one hundred items total; group and item IDs are unique.
Every item and the fallback is a validated safe destination; links remain real navigation when JavaScript or dialog.showModal is unavailable.
Icons are resolved only through the locked closed icon geometry map.
The optional Ctrl/Meta single-key shortcut ignores editable and composing targets; filtering and arrow/Home/End/Enter behavior remain local to the component.
Derived IDs include the dialog, title, search, results, instructions, every group label, and every item; reserve all against page collisions.
The component owns navigation presentation only; it never creates or submits application commands.
The Native host must separately admit its declared lifecycle script and native dialog behavior before integration is claimed.
